RESOLVED IN CODE - verified against R/metric.R. .compose_frame_metric implements composition = "sqrt_weight_congruence", law = D(sqrt(w)) K D(sqrt(w)), matching the proposal to 5.6e-17. Independently confirmed:
- diagonal specialization is BITWISE identical to diag(w) (identical() TRUE, diff exactly 0) - better than the sqrt round trip, no existing result changes
- coherent_functional = w/sum(w), label normalized_raw_frame_weight, metric_independent_orientation TRUE; a matches to 0
- component split exact to 0: max|K_coh + K_cfg - K_eff| = 0, rank(K_coh) = 1, K_cfg PSD
- denominator equals the predicted closed form (1/W^2) sqrt(w)^T Sigma sqrt(w) exactly
- conservation certificate: identity metrics give feature_additive TRUE + identity_conservation TRUE; local precisions give FALSE with global_metric_kind = support_pair_operator and an accurate reason; .require_metric_conservation refuses the precision case and passes the identity case
- README:225-227 and vignettes/introduction.Rmd:300-302 now state conservation as a compiled capability of the Euclidean K = I default
Recommend closing.
